description:
# Bible BSB

Read the Berean Standard Bible on Flipper Zero. The chapter text is bundled with the app, so reading works with no network connection and no extra download.

## How to read

Open the app from Apps, then Media.

- Up and Down move through books, chapters, verses, and reader lines
- Left and Right move across the chapter grid and turn reader pages
- OK opens the next screen. In the reader, a short press opens the menu and a long press saves the passage
- Back returns to the previous screen

Saved passages are stored at /ext/apps_data/bible_bsb/collection.json.

## Sharing

The reader menu can share the open passage as a route.bible link over NFC.

## License

This app is MIT licensed. The Berean Standard Bible text is in the public domain (dedicated April 30, 2023).
